title: Compute integer decimal magnitude without rounding
goal: Find the exact base-ten exponent of an integer when decimal digit budgets must preserve large values and define zero and negative-input rules.

prerequisites: SDK console project with Nullable and ImplicitUsings enabled; place each complete canonical helper in its own .cs file and add the imports stated in the offline instructions.
constraints: Nonnegative integer batch policy: zero has width one, negatives throw. Integer Log10 returns an exponent; width is an application rule.
